DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧ですか。行きたい場所がお決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the map? Have you decided where you would like to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二十分後に友人がこの入口へ迎えに来ます。それまで少し歩いて戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二十分後に同じ入口へ迎えが来るので短く歩きたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend is picking me up at this entrance in twenty minutes. I would like to take a short walk and return before then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your ride is coming to the same entrance in twenty minutes, so you want a short walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 待ち合わせまであまり時間がありませんね。一周するより、途中で引き返す経路を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is not much time until you meet. Let's consider a route where you turn back partway rather than make a full circuit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の展望場所まで行こうと思いましたが、戻る時間を考えると遠そうですね。近くに休める場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展望場所は遠いと判断し近くの休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was thinking of going to the viewpoint farther in, but it seems too far when I allow time to return. Is there somewhere nearby to rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide the viewpoint is too far and ask about a nearby resting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図のベンチの印を探しましょう。ここからの道には高低差の表示もあります。坂道は避けたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look for the bench symbols on the map. The paths from here also show changes in elevation. Would you like to avoid slopes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は足が疲れているので、上り坂を避けたいです。この入口の近くだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 足が疲れているので上り坂を避け入口近くにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My legs are tired today, so I would like to avoid uphill paths. I will stay near this entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your legs are tired, so you will avoid uphill paths and stay near the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、途中の標識でも入口の方向を確かめてください。今いる場所を案内図の現在地と照合しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please also check the direction of the entrance on signs along the way. Let's match where we are now to the map's current-location marker.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この現在地が今の入口ですね。似た入口を間違えないよう、入口名を友人にも送っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在地が入口と確認し入口名を友人へ送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: This current-location marker is the entrance we are at, right? I will send my friend the entrance's name so we do not confuse it with a similar entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the current location is the entrance and say you will send its name to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 迎えの方にも場所が伝わりますね。戻る時刻を決めてから歩くと、途中で休んでも調整しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will let the person picking you up know the location too. Setting a return time before you walk makes it easier to adjust even if you rest along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五分歩いたら折り返します。早めにここへ戻って、座って友人を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五分で折り返し早めに戻って座って待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will turn back after walking for five minutes. I will return here early and sit down to wait for my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will turn back after five minutes, return early and sit while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 疲れたら途中でも引き返してくださいね。それでは、足元にお気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: If you get tired, turn back even before then. Watch your footing, and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 掲示板の運転見合わせについてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the service suspension shown on the noticeboard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。乗る予定の列車が止まっています。取引先との待ち合わせに間に合うか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗る予定の列車が止まり取引先との待ち合わせに間に合うか心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The train I planned to take has stopped running. I am worried I will not make my appointment with a business client.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your planned train is not running and you are worried about reaching your appointment with a business client on time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今のところ再開時刻は未定です。待ち合わせまで、あとどのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: At present there is no set time for service to resume. How long is it until your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あと四十分です。再開したとしても、すぐ出発できるとは限らないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待ち合わせまで四十分で、再開後すぐに出発できるとは限らないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Forty minutes. Even if service resumes, does that mean the train might not leave straight away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the appointment is in forty minutes and confirm that departure may not be immediate after service resumes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。再開後も順番に運転するため、出発までお待ちいただく場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Even after service resumes, trains run in sequence, so you may have to wait before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら先方に時間の変更を相談します。待つ場合は、どこで次の案内を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先方に時間変更を相談し、待つ場合の次の案内をどこで確認するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: In that case I will discuss changing the time with them. If I wait, where can I check the next update?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss changing the time and ask where to check the next update if you wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この改札前の表示と放送でご案内します。別の交通手段に変える場合は、お持ちの切符も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We provide updates on the display here in front of the gates and through announcements. If you switch to another form of transport, we will also check your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ改札には入っていません。この切符を払い戻すと、手数料がかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未入場の切符を示し、払い戻し手数料がかかるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not gone through the gates yet. Is there a fee if I refund this ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the ticket you have not used to enter and ask whether there is a refund fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符の種類と運休の扱いを確認してからご説明します。払い戻すかどうかは、その後でお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain after checking the ticket type and how the suspension is handled. Please decide whether to get a refund after that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、先に電話して予定を調整します。払い戻しの条件を聞いてから、待つか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先方に電話して予定を調整し、払い戻し条件を聞いてから待つか決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will call them first to adjust our plans. After hearing the refund conditions, I will decide whether to wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Call the other party to adjust your plans, then decide whether to wait after hearing the refund conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。お戻りになりましたら、切符をこちらにお持ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. When you return, please bring your ticket here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの担当に相談するか、お迷いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you unsure which department to consult?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知に回答期限が書いてありますが、何を提出するのか読み取れません。相談の予約はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 回答期限のある通知で提出物がわからず相談の予約を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notice gives a deadline for replying, but I cannot work out what I need to submit. Can I book a consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not understand what to submit for a notice with a reply deadline and want a consultation appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 差出人の欄を拝見します。担当に受付方法を確認しますので、ご都合のよい時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look at the sender field. I will check the consultation procedure with the department, so please tell me what times suit you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務の交代時間なら来られます。来週の午前中に空きがあるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務の交代時間なら来られ、来週午前の空きを知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can come around my shift change. I would like to know if any mornings are available next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can come around your shift change and want to know about morning openings next week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 来週の空きは担当への確認が必要です。先に、この回答期限が来週より前ではないか確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check next week's availability with the department. First, let's make sure this reply deadline is not before next week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 期限は今週の金曜日でした。予約を待たずに、今日できることを聞いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限は今週金曜日であり、予約を待たず今日できることを聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The deadline is this Friday. Rather than wait for an appointment, I would like to ask what I can do today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the deadline is this Friday and you want to ask what you can do today without waiting for an appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では担当に、期限のある通知の相談としておつなぎします。説明を聞く際に必要な支援はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will connect you to the department about a notice with a deadline. Do you need any support when hearing the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 早口だと聞き取れないので、ゆっくり話してほしいです。難しい言葉は紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ゆっくりした説明と難しい言葉の書き出しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot follow fast speech, so I would like them to speak slowly. Could they write difficult words on paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a slow explanation and for difficult words to be written down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を伝えます。予約が必要となった場合も、期限への対応を先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on that request. Even if an appointment is necessary, please first check how to deal with the deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当につないでください。必要な提出物と、間に合わない場合の相談方法をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当につないでもらい提出物と期限に間に合わない場合の相談方法をメモすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please connect me to the department. I will note the required submissions and how to seek advice if I cannot meet the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to be connected to the department and say you will note what to submit and how to seek advice if you cannot meet the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでおつなぎします。通知は手元に置いておいてください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you here. Please keep the notice at hand. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次回の診察についてはお伝えしましたね。ほかに聞いておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have discussed your next appointment. Is there anything else you would like to ask?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場から受診した日のわかる書類を求められました。会計でもらった領収書と明細書は、違うものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受診日のわかる書類を求められ、領収書と明細書の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace asked for a document showing the date I visited. Are the receipt and itemized statement I got at payment different?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you need a document showing the visit date and ask the difference between the receipt and itemized statement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書は支払いを、明細書は診療の内訳を示します。職場がどちらを求めているかは、提出先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The receipt shows payment, while the statement shows the treatment breakdown. Please check with your workplace which they require.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 病名まで書いた書類が必要かもしれません。領収書だけでは病名は証明できないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 病名を記載した書類が必要かもしれず領収書だけでは証明できないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They might need a document that includes the diagnosis. So the receipt alone cannot prove the diagnosis, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that a document naming the diagnosis may be required and confirm that the receipt alone cannot prove it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。病名を記載した診断書が必要なら、医師への依頼になります。今、職場に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. If you need a medical certificate with the diagnosis, that is a request to the doctor. Can you check with your workplace now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者が会議中なので、まだ確認できません。診断書の申請方法だけ先に聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当者が会議中で確認できないため診断書の申請方法を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The person responsible is in a meeting, so I cannot check yet. Could I first ask how to apply for a medical certificate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot check because the person responsible is in a meeting, and first ask how to apply for a certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申請窓口をご案内します。書式の指定があるかも職場に聞いてください。費用や作成日数は窓口で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will direct you to the application desk. Also ask your workplace whether they specify a form. You can check the cost and preparation time at the desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の指定用紙があるか聞いてみます。その用紙がある場合は、持参して申請するということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場に指定用紙の有無を聞き、ある場合の持参申請を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask whether the company has a specified form. If it does, I bring that form when applying, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask your workplace about a specified form and confirm that you should bring it when applying if there is one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 指定用紙をお持ちになって、記入できる内容を窓口で相談してください。お渡しした領収書と明細書も保管しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bring the specified form and ask at the desk what can be filled in. Please also keep the receipt and statement we gave you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚ともなくさないようにします。今日は申請先だけ確かめて、職場の返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書と明細書を保管し、申請先を確認して職場の返事を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will make sure not to lose either sheet. Today I will only check where to apply and wait for my workplace's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the receipt and statement, check where to apply and wait for your workplace's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それがよいと思います。申請窓口は会計でお尋ねください。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I think that is best. Please ask at payment where the application desk is. Take care and get well soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた物のご相談ですね。何が見当たらなくなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to report a lost item. What has gone missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 灰色の長財布です。帰宅して鞄を開けたらなくて、途中で落としたのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 灰色の長財布が帰宅後に鞄になく途中で落としたかもしれないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A gray long wallet. When I got home and opened my bag, it was not there. I may have dropped it along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your gray long wallet was missing from your bag after you got home and may have been dropped along the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 財布を最後に使った時刻と、なくなったと気づいた時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me when you last used the wallet and when you noticed it was missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使ったのは午後一時半ごろ、駅前の店です。気づいたのは三時ですが、その間は財布を見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午後一時半に駅前の店で使い三時に気づきその間は確認していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used it around one thirty in the afternoon at a shop in front of the station. I noticed at three, but did not see the wallet in between.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you used it at a shop by the station around one thirty and noticed at three, without checking in between. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、落とした時刻は不明ですね。持ち主を確認する手がかりになるものは入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then the time you dropped it is unknown. Was there anything inside that could help identify the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 内側に名前の刺繍があります。現金のほかに銀行のカードも入れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内側の名前の刺繍と現金、銀行カードについて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My name is embroidered inside. Besides cash, I had a bank card in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the embroidered name inside, the cash and the bank card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前も記録します。銀行には利用停止について早めに連絡してください。見つかった場合の連絡先もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record the name too. Please promptly contact the bank about blocking the card. We also need a contact number in case it is found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯番号を書きます。仕事中は出られないことがあるので、着信があれば折り返してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯番号を伝え仕事中は出られないため折り返してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write my mobile number. Sometimes I cannot answer at work. May I return the call if I see a missed call?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide your mobile number and ask if you may call back because you cannot always answer at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。折り返すときは、こちらの担当と届け出の受付番号を伝えてください。番号を書いた控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you call back, give our department and the report receipt number. I will give you a copy showing that number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを持っておきます。財布の件とは別に、今から銀行へ連絡してカードの停止を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付控えを保管し今から銀行にカード利用停止を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the copy. Separately from the wallet report, I will now contact the bank about blocking the card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the report copy and contact the bank now about blocking the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。ご自分で財布を見つけた場合も、こちらへお知らせください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. If you find the wallet yourself, please let us know too. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受け取りですか。不在票を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect a parcel? May I see your missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。家では受け取りにくいので、今日この窓口で受け取れると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家で受け取りにくく今日この窓口で受け取れると思って来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. It is hard for me to receive it at home, so I came thinking I could collect it here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that home delivery is difficult and you came expecting to collect it at this counter today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 票に書かれた保管先が別の局ですね。今ここに荷物があるわけではありません。今日中のお受け取りを希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The storage location on the notice is another post office. The parcel is not here at the moment. Were you hoping to collect it today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 急いではいません。別の局まで行くより、明日の夕方に再配達を頼みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の局へ行くより明日の夕方の再配達を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is not urgent. Rather than go to another office, I would like redelivery tomorrow evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you prefer redelivery tomorrow evening to going to another post office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、不在票の案内に沿って申し込める時間帯を確認しましょう。保管期限もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's follow the notice and check which time slots you can request. Please check the storage deadline too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の夕方は選べるのですね。期限は明後日ですが、受け取れなかったらどうすればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明日夕方の選択を確認し明後日の期限までに受け取れない場合の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So tomorrow evening can be selected. The deadline is the day after tomorrow, but what should I do if I cannot receive it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm tomorrow evening is available and ask what to do if you cannot receive it before the deadline the following day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期限を過ぎる前に、票に記載された連絡先へ相談してください。何も連絡せず、そのままにしないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consult the contact on the notice before the deadline passes. Please do not just leave it without contacting anyone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 了解しました。申し込みができたかどうかは、画面のどこで確かめればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申し込みができたか画面のどこで確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Where on the screen can I check whether my request has been submitted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where on the screen to check whether the request has been submitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に出る受付内容を見て、日付と時間帯を確認してください。完了の表示が出る前に画面を閉じないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Look at the request details shown at the end and check the date and time slot. Do not close the screen before the completion message appears.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付が完了したら内容を保存します。明日はその時間に家にいるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付完了後に内容を保存し明日は配達時間に在宅すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will save the details once the request is complete. I will make sure I am at home at that time tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will save the details after completion and be home at the delivery time tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。お申し込み中に不明な点が出たら、不在票の問い合わせ先をご利用ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If anything is unclear while applying, use the inquiry contact on the notice. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失でしたら、先に利用停止の手続きを確認します。ご本人の口座でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: For a lost card, we will first check the procedure to block its use. Is it your own account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の口座です。財布からカードだけなくなっていて、家に置いたのか落としたのか判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人の口座でカードだけ見当たらず家に置いたか落としたか不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my account. Only the card is missing from my wallet. I cannot tell whether I left it at home or dropped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is your account, only the card is missing, and you do not know whether it is at home or lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所がわからない段階でもご相談いただけます。本人確認のため、お名前とお持ちの確認書類をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can consult us even while its location is unknown. For identification, please give your name and the identification documents you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。在留カードを持ってきましたが、通帳は家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前を示し在留カードはあるが通帳は家だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name is here. I brought my residence card, but my passbook is at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your name and explain that you have your residence card but your passbook is at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この書類で確認を進められるか担当が調べます。暗証番号は口に出さないでください。最近使った時刻は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check whether this document can be used to proceed. Do not say your PIN aloud. Do you remember when you last used the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夜、現金を引き出しました。それ以降の取引があるかも調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨夜の現金引き出しとそれ以降の取引を調べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I withdrew cash last night. I also want to check whether there have been any transactions since then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe last night's cash withdrawal and say you want to check transactions since then. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用停止の受付とあわせて、取引の確認方法をご案内します。再発行についてもお尋ねになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Along with accepting the blocking request, we will explain how to check transactions. Would you also like to ask about reissuing the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ただ、再発行を頼む前に、カードが家で見つかった場合の扱いを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再発行前に家で見つかった場合のカードの扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But before requesting a replacement, I want to know what happens if I find the card at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Before requesting a replacement, ask how the card is handled if found at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかっても、そのまま使わず銀行にご連絡ください。停止の解除や再発行後の扱いは、手続きの状況を確認してお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if you find it, contact the bank rather than simply using it. We will check the procedure's status before explaining how to unblock it or handle it after reissue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見つけたら連絡します。まず停止の受付を進めて、再発行の費用と必要書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見時は銀行へ連絡し停止受付を進め、再発行費用と必要書類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact you if I find it. First please proceed with the blocking request, and tell me the replacement fee and required documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the bank if it is found, proceed with blocking and ask the replacement fee and required documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 順番に確認しますので、こちらの席へどうぞ。確認書類をお忘れにならないよう、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check each point in order, so please take this seat. Be careful not to leave your identification documents behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちになった商品のことでしょうか。袋の下に受け皿を置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the product you brought? I will put a tray under the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った牛乳が、冷蔵庫の中で少し漏れていました。まだ開けていないのに、底が湿っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日購入した未開封の牛乳が冷蔵庫で漏れ容器の底が湿っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The milk I bought yesterday leaked a little in the fridge. The bottom is wet even though I have not opened it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the unopened milk bought yesterday leaked in the fridge and the container's bottom is wet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 容器とレシートを確認します。お買い物の後、持ち帰ってすぐ冷蔵庫に入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the container and receipt. After shopping, did you put it in the fridge as soon as you got home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家まで十分ほどで、すぐ入れました。今朝、棚に白い液体がたまっているのを見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十分ほどで帰宅しすぐ冷蔵し今朝棚の白い液体に気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It took about ten minutes to get home, and I put it in straight away. This morning I found white liquid pooled on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you got home in about ten minutes, refrigerated it immediately and noticed white liquid on the shelf this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いつ漏れ始めたかはわからないのですね。残りは口にせず、そのままの状態で確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you do not know when it began leaking. Please do not drink what remains and let us inspect it as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飲んではいません。今は袋を二重にしていますが、ここに出したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲んでおらず二重の袋に入れてあり取り出すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not drunk any. It is in two bags now. Should I take it out here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not drunk it, it is double-bagged and ask whether to take it out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋ごとお預かりします。交換か返金か、担当者が状態と購入記録を見て判断します。ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will take it with the bags. The person responsible will inspect the condition and purchase record to decide on exchange or refund. Do you have a preference?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ商品への交換を希望します。在庫がなければ返金について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ商品への交換を希望し在庫がなければ返金を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would prefer an exchange for the same product. If it is out of stock, I would like to discuss a refund.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request exchange for the same product and say you would discuss a refund if it is out of stock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を伝えます。今日は担当者の確認まで少しお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on. Could you wait a little today while the person responsible checks it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、待てます。漏れた容器は触らずに渡しますので、確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待てると答え漏れた容器を触らず渡し確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I can wait. I will hand over the leaking container without handling it, so please inspect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you can wait, hand over the leaking container without touching it and ask for an inspection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受け皿の上に置いてください。確認後はこちらからお声がけします。お持ちいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please put it on the tray. We will speak to you after checking it. Thank you for bringing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧ですか。歩く道をお探しでしたら、一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the map? If you are looking for a walking route, I can check it with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は足が疲れています。長く歩かずに、少しだけ外の空気を吸いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 足が疲れていて長く歩かず少し外の空気を吸いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My legs are tired today. I want a little fresh air without walking far.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your legs are tired and you want a little fresh air without a long walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一周するより、途中で引き返せる往復の道がよさそうですね。どの入口からいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: An out-and-back route where you can turn around partway seems better than a circuit. Which entrance did you come through?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駐輪場のある入口です。自転車をそこに置いたので、帰りも同じ場所に戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駐輪場のある入口から入り自転車を置いた同じ場所へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The entrance with the bicycle parking. I left my bicycle there, so I want to return to the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you entered by the bicycle parking and want to return to the same place where you left your bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図では、この道が入口から広場まで続いています。階段のある道は避けられますが、今日はまだ路面を確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: On the map, this path runs from the entrance to the plaza. You can avoid the path with stairs, but I have not checked the surface today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日雨が降ったので、水たまりがあれば引き返します。広場に着く前に座れる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 雨後の水たまりがあれば引き返し広場の手前で座れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It rained yesterday, so I will turn back if there are puddles. Is there somewhere to sit before reaching the plaza?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will turn back if there are puddles after the rain and ask about seats before the plaza. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図にベンチの表示があります。空いているかはわかりませんので、座れなければ無理に先へ進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a bench symbol on the map. I do not know if it is free, so please do not push on if you cannot sit down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場まで行くことにはこだわりません。ベンチの所で休んで、同じ道を戻ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 広場にはこだわらずベンチで休んで同じ道を戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not insist on reaching the plaza. I will rest at the bench and return along the same path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not need to reach the plaza and will rest at the bench and return by the same route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら分かれ道で別の道へ入らず、来た道を戻ってください。現在地と駐輪場の印も覚えておくと安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then return along the way you came rather than taking another path at a junction. Remembering the current-location and bicycle-parking markers is reassuring too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内図を撮ってから歩きます。疲れが増したら、ベンチまで行かずに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内図を撮り疲れが増せばベンチまで進まず戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will photograph this map before walking. If my legs get more tired, I will return without going as far as the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph the map and turn back before the bench if fatigue increases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ご自分のペースでどうぞ。滑りやすい所を避けて、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, go at your own pace. Avoid slippery places, and take care on your way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お出かけですね。切符をお求めでしたら、行き先を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Heading out? If you would like a ticket, please tell me your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宇部駅まで行きたいのですが、帰りは友人と相談して決めるので、往復で買うか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復か片道かを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to Ube Station, but I will decide the return trip after discussing it with a friend, so I am unsure whether to buy a return ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Decide between a return and a one-way ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 帰りの列車が決まっていなくても、まず片道を買う方法があります。今日はどの列車に乗る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even if you have not chosen a return train, you can first buy a one-way ticket. Which train do you plan to take today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この時刻表の次の普通列車です。手持ちの交通系カードで乗れる区間かも調べていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入前にカードが使えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The next local train on this timetable. Could you also check whether my transit card works on this section?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the card can be used before buying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カードの種類と利用区間を確認しますので、券面を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show me the card so I can check its type and the section where you can use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。使えなければ、現金で紙の切符を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認と購入の準備を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. If it cannot be used, I would like to buy a paper ticket with cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Proceed with the checks and prepare to buy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: このカードの利用条件を確認する間に、券売機で買う手順もご案内します。画面で行き先と金額を確認してからお金を入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: While checking this card's conditions, I will explain how to buy from the ticket machine too. Check the destination and fare on the screen before inserting money.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に片道を買います。帰りの切符は宇部駅で買う、という形でもよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰りの切符の用意も理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy a one-way ticket first. It is all right to buy the return ticket at Ube Station, then?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand how to prepare the return ticket too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、帰りは出発前に必要な切符をご用意ください。今お求めになるのは、宇部駅までの大人一枚ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, prepare the ticket you need before departing on the return journey. Right now you want one adult ticket to Ube Station, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大人一枚でお願いします。受け取ったら行き先を確かめて、乗り場へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符を受け取り乗り場へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: One adult ticket, please. When I receive it, I will check the destination and head to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the ticket and proceed to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。切符とお釣りをお忘れなく。それでは、気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please remember your ticket and change. Have a safe trip.
